ValidationRule.description: Stages move forward one step at a time. Credit Review may go straight to Approved. Declined and Withdrawn are allowed from any stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Stage__c), CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c)), "Draft", 1, "Intake Complete", 2, "Documents Pending", 3, "Underwriting", 4, "Credit Review", 5, "Conditionally Approved", 6, "Approved", 7, "Closing", 8, "Booked", 9, 0) > 0, CASE(TEXT(Stage__c), "Draft", 1, "Intake Complete", 2, "Documents Pending", 3, "Underwriting", 4, "Credit Review", 5, "Conditionally Approved", 6, "Approved", 7, "Closing", 8, "Booked", 9, 0) > CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c)), "Draft", 1, "Intake Complete", 2, "Documents Pending", 3, "Underwriting", 4, "Credit Review", 5, "Conditionally Approved", 6, "Approved", 7, "Closing", 8, "Booked", 9, 0) + 1, NOT(AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c), "Credit Review"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Approved"))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Stages must advance one step at a time. Move the application to the next stage in sequence.
